dedupe_keys.name: eurostat oil pipeline statistics transport by coverage and product pipe go ttkm and investment and maintenance expenditure pipe ec invest

description: Eurostat publishes annual statistics on oil pipeline transport in Europe. Read through the Eurostat statistics interface on 2026-09-28, the transport table PIPE_GO_TTKM gives tonnes and tonne-kilometres moved by pipeline within each country, split into total, crude oil and refined products and into national, international loaded, international unloaded and transit transport, for 31 reporting countries from 1970 to 2024, last updated in July 2026. The companion table PIPE_EC_INVEST gives investment and maintenance spending on oil pipeline infrastructure in million euros for 22 countries from 1990 to 2024, updated in September 2026. The same data family also lists tables on pipeline employment, enterprises, capacity and length, which were not opened. Coverage is EU member states and other reporting European countries. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 (European Commission reuse policy, Decision 2011/833/EU; Eurostat data reusable with source acknowledged). Access is free of charge. Caveats: many country series have gaps or confidential values, and national definitions of pipeline networks differ. It supports network flow and capacity studies, such as calibrating crude and product flows or transit volumes in a European oil supply model. No related record is catalogued for these tables yet.
